$comment: Central asking a node to stop a run, contract 1.11.0. Sent with `registry.send_text_frame` and never awaited — the same one-way shape `terminal.resize` uses. Termination on the node is three phases against the whole **process group**: SIGINT, a bounded wait, then SIGKILL, so `run.cancel` leaves no orphans behind (plan/18/04-…md §3.3).
